# Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.1-rc.5

Test candidate targeting the existing DL322 USA 260507 wireless configuration and HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8. No new Android Auto development or validation.

## Transport and recovery
- Generation guards reject obsolete queued component-5 attachment requests during teardown, new attachment and reattachment.
- Check receive readiness and enqueue under the same lock to avoid stranded pending packets; reject empty packets and late connected callbacks when the client is no longer active or USB is present.
- Preserve existing hotspot startup, native receiver and audio patches, shared identity API and CPUL contributions.
- Add startup/authentication timings, pending receive overflow totals, flush results and teardown snapshots with transmit queue and blocked-send diagnostics.

## Diagnostics
- Bounded asynchronous per-session journal, redacted Java events with wall-clock and monotonic timestamps, explicit queue overflow and truncation markers.
- Capture creation/start/finalization milestones, separate repeated creation attempts, recover interrupted sessions, and avoid publishing failed recordings as complete.
- Optional native TccCarPlay capture with bounded rotation and cleanup of recovered markers. Native logs are raw and may include private information.
- Automatic USB export to WCP-LOGS, including delayed USB insertion; completed files only, with mount and symlink checks.
- Automated journal, attachment generation, recovery and exporter regressions.

## Compatibility and known limitations
- Keep WCP integrated TBT off when using Standalone TBT.
- No changes to AirPlay video capabilities, native frame timeout, CPUL playback or parked-video restrictions. Supplementary playback disconnect remains under investigation.
- Exclusive wired mode and EWF independence are documented research, not implemented. Turning off bridge/audio does not withdraw global hotspot/feature requests. USB dongle compatibility with CPUL sidebars is unverified.
- HMG-API external-file conflicts after EWF removal must be resolved separately; installing this update is not a verified fix.
- Concurrent Binder receive ordering and asynchronous detach/attach ordering remain potential races requiring evidence before further changes.
- Full CI passed on the development baseline; vehicle validation of RC5 is pending. Keep current author signing identity and do not remove backups.
